summary: NatWest Group plc filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of $1.25 billion 4.983% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Notes due 2032. The issuance is a routine debt capital markets transaction — the funds will be raised from public investors, not a special situation event. The notes pay semi-annual interest, are unsecured unsubordinated obligations ranking equally with other senior debt, and include UK bail-in language. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other corporate-change event is involved. The filing is a standard shelf takedown for new debt.
